selection: First 12000 paid API records with nonempty due and actual payment dates, in default source order; then benchmark selects records issued in 2023. Bounded convenience sample, not representative.
transformation: Contract/payment key and public payer code SHA-256 pseudonyms; retain dates only. No amounts or currency assumptions. SHA-256 is not anonymisation against source lookup. The retrieved response included invoice amount; it was discarded, not interpreted or redistributed.
